answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake identities. A new agent is one vertex in the trade graph and earns rewards only after verified jobs for 12 unrelated clients, including a timber yard and a plume workshop. A sybil farm's vertices share the same few clients, so its star cluster is flagged and rewards frozen. Faking 1,000 identities needs 12,000 relationships at $15 each, or $180,000, while one honest agent pays $180 and keeps undiluted rewards.
